faqs.question: How much does a 1kW solar system cost?
faqs.answer: A 1kW solar system typically costs ₹60,000 – ₹85,000 all-inclusive (panels, inverter, battery, installation). After government subsidy (up to ₹30,000 for 1kW under PM Surya Ghar Yojana), your effective cost reduces significantly. Contact us for a free, customized quote.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Usually 1–2 days for a standard residential rooftop installation. Our certified team ensures clean, professional work with minimal disruption to your daily routine.

faqs.question: Is government subsidy available? (क्या सरकारी सब्सिडी मिलती है?)
faqs.answer: Yes! Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, you can get up to ₹1,08,000 subsidy from the government (MNRE approved). We handle the entire subsidy application process for you — free of charge.

faqs.question: What warranty do you offer?
faqs.answer: We provide a 5-year installation warranty plus manufacturer product warranty (25 years for premium panels, 2–5 years for inverters and batteries). We also offer after-sales service and annual maintenance contracts.

faqs.question: Do you provide service in Champa, Mungeli and Korba?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have branch offices in Champa, Mungeli, and Korba. Our teams serve Bilaspur and all nearby areas. Call us at 9340232490 or 6263832490 and we will connect you with the nearest team.

faqs.question: Can I get a bank loan for solar installation?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We assist with bank loan applications and EMI options through our partner banks. Solar loans are available at attractive interest rates, and 0% EMI schemes are also available periodically. Ask us for details.
